properties.name: replace_text: one sentence of a node's text moves, or a note is appended, without re-sending the field
properties.rationale: Anthony 2026-09-18 ('let's start addressing these and implementing fixes'), increment B of the flo2 triage: option (a) of the idea — a unique-string replace with an append mode — chosen over a Decision-level `chosen` property because it serves every long field, not one type.
properties.summary: New tool replace_text (capture.rs) + ReplaceTextReq (service.rs); corpus entry; brainstorm and revise-design skill lines (+ mirrors); four integration tests; CHANGELOG.
